evidence_chain.link: Marfan syndrome is characterized by ocular findings including ectopia lentis.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is also associated with ocular findings such as lens dislocation.
Homocystinuria is a different condition that can also cause lens dislocation, but it is not as strongly associated with the other features of the case.
evidence_chain.quote: homocystinuria due to cystathionine beta-synthase deficiency

ranked_facts.why: The presence of bilateral inferior lens dislocation is a key feature of both Marfan syndrome and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, which are represented by candidates B1 and B2, respectively.

8fcb27f05db49a24de3e5ed18272b012f1de63b7.why: Requesting chunks for bilateral inferior lens dislocation and height above the 99th percentile to inform the differential diagnosis of Marfan syndrome and other genetic disorders.
